name: Cherry blossom tree
style: low-poly, flat colours, rounded faceted canopy (Quaternius 2019), recoloured pink

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row #159 was a gap. The first candidate, light-game-studio's "Lowpoly Sakura Tree" (https://opengameart.org/content/lowpoly-sakura-tree, Tree2.blend, CC0 on the page, sha256 af470d739591b83179be29b843133996b77b686e6579502a52f5851646a1f40a), was ingested and rendered but read badly: six small blossom balls on a thick, bent trunk, a claw-like silhouette at hero size. This is Quaternius's CommonTree_1 from the Ultimate Nature Pack on OpenGameArt (License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0), whose wide, flat, two-lobed canopy on a forked trunk is the classic spreading sakura shape; both leaf materials are recoloured to the festival script's pale pink with a rose shade. Height 6 m: a mature Somei-yoshino in a park or school yard is 5-8 m and wider than tall; here the canopy is about 6.7 x 4.6 m and starts at 3.5 m, so a 1.6 m person walks under it. Static: no clips.
